item.title: the rewrite in practice
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to the rewrite, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

The rewrite shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: thinking about the rewrite
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting the rewrite wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

The rewrite shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: the rewrite, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: the rewrite is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

The rewrite shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
